title: Oslo I Accord is signed at the White House
summary: Israel and the PLO signed a declaration of principles on Palestinian self-rule, sealed by a handshake between Yitzhak Rabin and Yasser Arafat.
reason: Secret talks in Norway after the first intifada and the Gulf War produced mutual recognition.
significance: It created the Palestinian Authority and framed peace efforts for decades.
place: White House, Washington, D.C., United States
